data.selection: Reuse the immutable R72 fit/eval membership; no resampling, new cohort or official valid/test reads.
data.independence: Development partition has repeatedly informed ideation. A positive result cannot independently confirm a newly selected claim.

profile_policy: Every kind: first32 fit order warmup, same first32 timed, then longest32 fit units ordered by descending token count and ascending immutable source index.12 backward calls;0 updates;all state hashes unchanged. Never evaluate or report losses or model metrics. Full-prefix loader validates all labels in0..39 but no evaluation label enters a loss or selection.
resource_estimator: ceil(392*sum(max(first_fit,longest_fit seconds) per kind)*2+300);planning estimate only,not automatic training admission or runtime guarantee.
training_eligibility: Dormant train/range code needs separate reviewed measured resource/recovery/launch contract plus range/reload fixture before use.
memory_policy: 8192MiB is a run-wide Torch-allocator acceptance threshold covering setup,warmups and transitions; no hard device cap or complete CUDA-context claim. Perbatch high-water fields are cumulative; warmups excluded only from timing extrapolation.
dormant_training_corrections: Range diagnostics explicitly check finite direct quadratic coordinate/readout identities; selected-range fixture still pending. Checkpoint writes stage0600+fsync,exact reload before atomic final rename;all files/hash/byte cap checked before marker. Failure leaves private unclaimed partials,new attempt cannot adopt them.
